headline: BI Head Admits Rupiah Still Weakening, But Not as Bad as in First Half of 2026
summary: As of 23 November 2026, the rupiah had weakened 9.54% year to date to 18,195 per US dollar. Bank Indonesia acknowledged the currency is still weakening but less sharply than in the first half.
why: The rupiah's exchange rate affects import costs, inflation and dollar-denominated debt for Indonesian companies and government. Bank Indonesia manages the currency alongside its inflation and growth targets.
original_headline: Bos BI Akui Rupiah Masih Melemah, Tapi Tak Seburuk Semester I-2026
